To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the disturbing effects of PMSMs drives are significantly influenced by the control strategy and also by the type and parameters of filters used at the converters of these drives.
the disturbing effects in rail vehicle drives with PMSM can be reduced by the use of the suitable configuration of the drive.
the disturbing effects of PMSM drives of four-wheel drive vehicle are not significant and they are in the range of EMC requirements for railway vehicles.

the analysis of the disturbing effects at the configuration of four-wheel drive.
the problem of the disturbing effects in the rail vehicle drive with PMSMs.
the analysis of the disturbing effects in the rail vehicle traction drive with permanent magnets synchronous motors (PMSGMs).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the disturbing effects of the PMSM drives of the four-wheeled vehicle are significantly influenced by the control strategy, the type of filters and the configuration of the drive.
the simulation model of a vehicle drive is a very useful tool for the investigation of disturbing currents of the drive and for a selection of the best configuration of the bogie.
the simulation model of the four-wheel drive vehicle with PMSMs can be used as a tool for EMC research.

the researches of disturbing currents in the traction drive of a wheel multi-axele vehicle were focused on the analysis and simulation of the influence of the configuration of four drives in the vehicle on the level of current harmonic spectrum.
the research of disturbing effects of PMSMs drives for multi-axle vehicles should be focused on the research of disturbing components of the current harmonics at the level of one drive.
the simulation of the drive of the vehicle with PMSM drives is an important tool of research and design for EMC of this drive.

the simulation models of the vehicle with PMSM drive can be utilized for research of disturbing effects in the drive of the vehicle.
the simulation model of the drive can be used for the analysis of disturbing effects of traction drives.
